info.title: VTEX CX API
info.description:
VTEX CX API.

## Index

### Authentication
- `GET` [Get a session token](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/projects/-project_uuid-/token)
- `POST` [Invalidate a session token](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#post-/api/v1/projects/-project_uuid-/invalidate-token)

### Platform
- `GET` [List organizations](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/organizations)
- `POST` [Create an organization](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#post-/api/v1/organizations)
- `GET` [List projects](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/organizations/-organization_uuid-/projects)
- `POST` [Create a project](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#post-/api/v1/organizations/-organization_uuid-/projects)

### Contacts
- `GET` [List contacts](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/contacts)
- `POST` [Create or update a contact](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#post-/api/v1/contacts)
- `DELETE` [Delete a contact](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#delete-/api/v1/contacts)
- `GET` [List contact fields](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/contact-fields)
- `POST` [Create or update a contact field](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#post-/api/v1/contact-fields)

### Messaging
- `GET` [List messages](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/messages)

### Events
- `GET` [List events](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/events)

### Rooms
- `GET` [List rooms](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/rooms)
- `GET` [Retrieve a room](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/rooms/-uuid-)
- `GET` [List room messages](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/room-messages)
- `POST` [Create a room message](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#post-/api/v1/room-messages)

### Conversations
- `GET` [List project conversations](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/projects/-project_uuid-/conversations)

### Automation flows
- `GET` [List flows](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/automation-flows)
- `GET` [List flow starts](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/automation-flow-starts)
- `POST` [Start contacts in a flow](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#post-/api/v1/automation-flow-starts)
- `GET` [List flow runs](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/automation-flow-runs)

### Campaigns
- `GET` [List broadcasts](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/broadcasts)
- `POST` [Send a broadcast](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#post-/api/v1/broadcasts)

### Analytics
- `GET` [Get conversation totals](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/cx-api#get-/api/v1/conversation-totals)

get.description:
Lists the WhatsApp broadcasts sent by the project, most recent first.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Returns only the broadcast with this identifier.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Returns only broadcasts whose creation date is at or before this date and time, in ISO 8601 format. A value that cannot be parsed returns an empty list.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Returns only broadcasts whose creation date is at or after this date and time, in ISO 8601 format. A value that cannot be parsed returns an empty list.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor taken from the `next` or `previous` URL of a previous response. Use it to move between pages.

schema.description: Page of broadcasts, with links to the neighbouring pages.

next.description: URL of the next page, or `null` on the last page.

previous.description: URL of the previous page, or `null` on the first page.

urns.description: URNs that received the broadcast. It is `null` for anonymous projects.

groups.description: Contact groups that received the broadcast.

items.description: Contact group that received the broadcast.

text.description: Message text by language code. Broadcasts created through this endpoint keep their content in `metadata`, so this is `null` for them.

additionalProperties.description: Message text in the language of the key.

channel.description: Identifier of the channel used to send the broadcast, or `null` when none was set.

metadata.description: Content of the message as it was submitted, after validation. When a template is used, its name and identifier are filled in.

created_on.description: Date and time when the broadcast was created.

schema.description: Error returned when a query parameter is invalid.

example.detail: Value for id must be an integer

post.description:
Sends a WhatsApp broadcast to contacts, groups or URNs. The message is queued and sent asynchronously.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

schema.description: Broadcast to send. At least one of `urns`, `contacts`, `groups` or `recipients` is required.

urns.description: URNs to send to. Up to 1000 items.

items.description: Contact URN in the `scheme:path` format, for example `whatsapp:5511999998888`.

contacts.description: Contacts to send to, each by UUID or URN. Up to 1000 items.

groups.description: Contact groups to send to, each by UUID or name. Up to 100 items.

recipients.description: Recipients with their own template variables, for templates with named parameters. Up to 1000 items.

variables.description: Template variables for this recipient, keyed by name. Up to 100 entries.

msg.description: Content of the message. It must include at least one of `text`, `attachments`, `template`, `action_type` or `carousel`. Keys not listed here are passed through to the messaging service without validation.

text.description: Text of the message. It can use expressions such as `@contact.name`.

attachments.description: Attachments to send, each in the `content-type:url` format.

items.description: Attachment in the `content-type:url` format, for example `image/png:https://example.com/image.png`.

template.description: Approved WhatsApp template to send. Provide `uuid`, or `name` together with `channel`.

variables.description: Values for the template body, in positional order. Cannot be combined with `named_variables`.

named_variables.description: Values for templates with named parameters, keyed by parameter name. Cannot be combined with `variables`.

locale.description: Locale of the template, for example `pt-BR`.

is_carousel.description: Whether the template is a carousel template. Defaults to `false`.

items.description: Carousel card, passed through to the messaging service without validation.
Carousel card, passed through to the messaging service without validation.

custom_data.description: Custom JSON object sent with the message. It can be at most 16384 bytes when serialized and 32 levels deep, and its keys cannot start with `$` or contain `.`. An empty object is treated as omitted.

direct_send.description: Whether to send the message directly.

ttl_seconds.description: Time to live of the message, in seconds. It cannot be negative.

direct_send_template_name.description: Name of the template used for a direct send.

ig_comment_id.description: Identifier of the Instagram comment to answer. Requires `ig_response_type`.

ig_response_type.description: How to answer an Instagram comment. Requires `ig_comment_id`.

channel.description: UUID of the channel to send from. If a template is used, it must be available on this channel.

queue.description: Queue that processes the broadcast. `template_batch` requires `name` and `groups` and does not accept `contacts`.

name.description: Name of the broadcast. Required when `queue` is `template_batch`.

trigger_flow_uuid.description: UUID of the messaging or voice flow to start when a recipient replies. The flow must be active.

schema.description: WhatsApp broadcast.

urns.description: URNs that received the broadcast. It is `null` for anonymous projects.

groups.description: Contact groups that received the broadcast.

items.description: Contact group that received the broadcast.

text.description: Message text by language code. Broadcasts created through this endpoint keep their content in `metadata`, so this is `null` for them.

additionalProperties.description: Message text in the language of the key.

channel.description: Identifier of the channel used to send the broadcast, or `null` when none was set.

metadata.description: Content of the message as it was submitted, after validation. When a template is used, its name and identifier are filled in.

created_on.description: Date and time when the broadcast was created.

schema.description: Validation errors. An error tied to a field is keyed by the field name and lists the messages that apply to it. Errors that do not belong to a single field use `non_field_errors`.

detail.description: Reason the request was rejected, returned when a query parameter is invalid.

non_field_errors.description: Errors that do not belong to a single field.

non_field_errors: Must provide either urns, contacts or groups

get.description:
Lists the contacts of the project, most recently modified first. Combine query parameters to filter the list.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Returns only the contact with this UUID.

parameters.name: urn
parameters.description: Returns only the contact that owns this URN. A phone number without a scheme is treated as a WhatsApp number.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Returns contacts whose name matches this value exactly, or that own the URN this value represents.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Returns contacts whose name contains this value, ignoring case.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Returns only contacts in the group with this UUID or name.

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: When `true`, returns deleted contacts instead of active ones.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Returns only contacts whose last modification is at or before this date and time, in ISO 8601 format. A value that cannot be parsed returns an empty list.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Returns only contacts whose last modification is at or after this date and time, in ISO 8601 format. A value that cannot be parsed returns an empty list.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Sorts the results. Any other value is ignored and the default order applies.

parameters.name: reverse
parameters.description: When `true`, returns the contacts that were modified first, instead of the latest. Ignored when `order_by` is set.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of contacts per page. Defaults to 250.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor taken from the `next` or `previous` URL of a previous response. Use it to move between pages.

schema.description: Page of contacts, with links to the neighbouring pages.

next.description: URL of the next page, or `null` on the last page.

previous.description: URL of the previous page, or `null` on the first page.

name.description: Name of the contact. It is `null` when the contact has no name.

language.description: Language of the contact, as an ISO 639-3 code. It is `null` when not set.

urns.description: URNs of the contact. In anonymous projects the path is masked.

groups.description: Contact groups the contact belongs to, including dynamic groups.

fields.description: Values of the project's contact fields, keyed by field key. A field with no value is `null`.

blocked.description: Whether the contact is blocked. It is `null` for deleted contacts.

stopped.description: Whether the contact is stopped. It is `null` for deleted contacts.

created_on.description: Date and time when the contact was created.

modified_on.description: Date and time when the contact was last modified.

last_seen_on.description: Date and time when the contact was last seen, or `null` if never.

schema.description: Error returned when a query parameter is invalid.

post.description:
Creates a contact, or updates an existing one. Without a lookup parameter the request creates a contact. With `uuid`, `urn` or `name`, it updates the contact that matches, and only the keys in the body change. If `urn` matches no contact, a new contact is created with that URN. Send at most one lookup parameter.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the contact to look up.

parameters.name: urn
parameters.description: URN of the contact to look up, for example `whatsapp:5511999998888`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Exact name of the contact to look up.

schema.description: Contact data. Keys that are not sent are left unchanged when updating.

name.description: Name of the contact. It is trimmed and can have up to 100 characters.

language.description: Language of the contact, as a three-letter ISO 639-3 code.

urns.description: URNs of the contact. Up to 100 items. When updating, the list replaces the current URNs.

items.description: Contact URN in the `scheme:path` format, for example `whatsapp:5511999998888`.

groups.description: Contact groups, each by UUID or name. Up to 100 items. When updating, the list replaces the contact's membership in static groups.

fields.description: Values for contact fields, keyed by field key. Up to 100 keys. Only the keys sent are changed, and an empty string clears the value.

name.description: Name of the contact. It is `null` when the contact has no name.

language.description: Language of the contact, as an ISO 639-3 code. It is `null` when not set.

urns.description: URNs of the contact. In anonymous projects the path is masked.

groups.description: Contact groups the contact belongs to, including dynamic groups.

fields.description: Values of the project's contact fields, keyed by field key. A field with no value is `null`.

created_on.description: Date and time when the contact was created.

modified_on.description: Date and time when the contact was last modified.

last_seen_on.description: Date and time when the contact was last seen, or `null` if never.

name.description: Name of the contact. It is `null` when the contact has no name.

language.description: Language of the contact, as an ISO 639-3 code. It is `null` when not set.

urns.description: URNs of the contact. In anonymous projects the path is masked.

groups.description: Contact groups the contact belongs to, including dynamic groups.

fields.description: Values of the project's contact fields, keyed by field key. A field with no value is `null`.

detail.description: Reason the request was rejected, returned when a query parameter is invalid.

non_field_errors.description: Errors that do not belong to a single field.

language: Not a valid ISO639-3 language code.

delete.description:
Deletes the contact identified by exactly one of `uuid`, `urn` or `name`.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the contact to look up.

parameters.name: urn
parameters.description: URN of the contact to look up, for example `whatsapp:5511999998888`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Exact name of the contact to look up.

schema.description: Error returned when a query parameter is invalid.

example.detail: URL must contain one of the following parameters: name, urn, uuid

get.description:
Lists the events stored in the data lake for the project, within a date range. The response is a plain array without `next` or `previous` links, so use `limit` and `offset` to page through it.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: date_start
parameters.description: Start of the period, in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: date_end
parameters.description: End of the period, in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: event_name
parameters.description: Returns only events with this name.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Returns only events with this key.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Returns only events with this value.

parameters.name: value_type
parameters.description: Returns only events whose value has this type.

parameters.name: contact_urn
parameters.description: Returns only events of the contact with this URN.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Filters events by their metadata.

parameters.name: silver
parameters.description: When `true`, queries a silver table instead of the default event source. It requires `table`.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Name of the silver table to query. Required when `silver` is `true`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 10 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of events to skip.

schema.description: List of events.

items.description: Event stored in the data lake. The properties depend on the event, so only `date` is documented here.

date.description: Date and time of the event. Returned only when the event has one.

schema.description: Validation errors, keyed by the name of the query parameter that failed.
Error returned when the events could not be fetched.

get.description:
Lists the active contact fields of the project, newest first. The page size is fixed at 250.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Returns only the field with this key.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor taken from the `next` or `previous` URL of a previous response. Use it to move between pages.

schema.description: Page of contact fields, with links to the neighbouring pages.

next.description: URL of the next page, or `null` on the last page.

previous.description: URL of the previous page, or `null` on the first page.

key.description: Unique key of the field in the project, generated from the label.

value_type.description: Type of the values the field holds.

pinned.description: Whether the field is shown in the contact table.

post.summary: Create or update a contact field
post.description:
Creates a contact field, or updates the one identified by `key`. When creating, the key is generated from the label. When updating, the key stays the same and both `label` and `value_type` are rewritten.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key of the field to update. Omit it to create a field.

schema.description: Contact field data. Both properties are required, also when updating.

label.description: Display name of the field. It can have up to 36 characters, using letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens and underscores, and must be unique in the project.

value_type.description: Type of the values the field holds.

schema.description: Contact field.

key.description: Unique key of the field in the project, generated from the label.

value_type.description: Type of the values the field holds.

pinned.description: Whether the field is shown in the contact table.

schema.description: Contact field.

key.description: Unique key of the field in the project, generated from the label.

value_type.description: Type of the values the field holds.

pinned.description: Whether the field is shown in the contact table.

schema.description: Validation errors. An error tied to a field is keyed by the field name and lists the messages that apply to it. Errors that do not belong to a single field use `non_field_errors`.

detail.description: Reason the request was rejected, returned when a query parameter is invalid.

non_field_errors.description: Errors that do not belong to a single field.

label: Can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.

get.description:
Lists the flow starts triggered by a user or through the API, most recently modified first. Starts created internally by the platform are not included. The page size is fixed at 250.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Returns only the flow start with this UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Returns only the flow start with this identifier. Deprecated, use `uuid`.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Returns only flow starts whose last modification is at or before this date and time, in ISO 8601 format. A value that cannot be parsed returns an empty list.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Returns only flow starts whose last modification is at or after this date and time, in ISO 8601 format. A value that cannot be parsed returns an empty list.

parameters.name: reverse
parameters.description: When `true`, returns the flow starts that were modified first, instead of the latest.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor taken from the `next` or `previous` URL of a previous response. Use it to move between pages.

schema.description: Page of flow starts, with links to the neighbouring pages.

next.description: URL of the next page, or `null` on the last page.

previous.description: URL of the previous page, or `null` on the first page.

id.description: Unique identifier of the flow start.

groups.description: Contact groups started in the flow.

items.description: Contact group started in the flow.

restart_participants.description: Whether participants already in the flow were restarted.

exclude_active.description: Whether contacts that were active in other flows were excluded.

extra.description: Extra parameters passed to the flow start.

params.description: Same content as `extra`, under its newer name.

created_on.description: Date and time when the flow start was created.

modified_on.description: Date and time when the flow start was last modified.

schema.description: Error returned when a query parameter is invalid.

example.detail: Value for uuid must be a valid UUID

post.description:
Starts contacts in a flow. Provide at least one of `groups`, `contacts` or `urns`. The contacts enter the flow asynchronously, so use the flow runs endpoint to follow the runs this start creates.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

schema.description: Flow start to create. `flow` is required, plus at least one of `groups`, `contacts` or `urns`.

flow.description: UUID of the flow to start contacts in.

groups.description: Contact groups to start in the flow, each by UUID or name. Up to 100 items.

contacts.description: Contacts to start in the flow, each by UUID or URN. Up to 100 items.

urns.description: URNs to start in the flow. Up to 100 items.

items.description: Contact URN in the `scheme:path` format, for example `whatsapp:5511999998888`.

restart_participants.description: Whether to restart contacts that are already in the flow. Defaults to `true`.

exclude_active.description: Whether to skip contacts that are currently active in another flow. Defaults to `false`.

params.description: Extra parameters for the flow, available as `@trigger.params`. String values longer than 4096 characters are truncated. When both `params` and `extra` are sent, `params` is used.

extra.description: Same as `params`, under its older name.

schema.description: Flow start.

id.description: Unique identifier of the flow start.

groups.description: Contact groups started in the flow.

items.description: Contact group started in the flow.

restart_participants.description: Whether participants already in the flow were restarted.

exclude_active.description: Whether contacts that were active in other flows were excluded.

extra.description: Extra parameters passed to the flow start.

params.description: Same content as `extra`, under its newer name.

created_on.description: Date and time when the flow start was created.

modified_on.description: Date and time when the flow start was last modified.

schema.description: Validation errors. An error tied to a field is keyed by the field name and lists the messages that apply to it. Errors that do not belong to a single field use `non_field_errors`.

detail.description: Reason the request was rejected, returned when a query parameter is invalid.

non_field_errors.description: Errors that do not belong to a single field.

non_field_errors: Must specify at least one group, contact or URN

get.description:
Lists the flows of the project, newest first by default. The list includes archived flows unless you filter with `archived`. System flows are not included.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Returns only the flow with this UUID.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Returns only flows of this type. Any other value returns an empty list.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: When sent, returns only archived flows if the value is `true`, `1`, `yes` or `y`, and only active flows for any other value.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Returns flows that have any of these labels, matched by name. Repeat the parameter to send more than one label.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Returns only flows whose last modification is at or before this date and time, in ISO 8601 format. A value that cannot be parsed returns an empty list.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Returns only flows whose last modification is at or after this date and time, in ISO 8601 format. A value that cannot be parsed returns an empty list.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Sorts the results. Defaults to `-created_on`. Any other value returns a status code `400` error.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of flows per page, up to 250. Defaults to 250.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of flows to skip. Sending it switches the response to limit and offset pagination, which adds `count` to the response and ignores `cursor`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor taken from the `next` or `previous` URL of a previous response. Use it to move between pages.

schema.description: Page of flows, with links to the neighbouring pages.

next.description: URL of the next page, or `null` on the last page.

previous.description: URL of the previous page, or `null` on the first page.

expires.description: Minutes of inactivity after which a run in this flow expires.

runs.description: Number of runs of the flow, by status.

node_uuids.description: Nodes of the flow that save this result.

parent_refs.description: Keys of the parent flow results that this flow references.

items.description: Key of a parent flow result.

created_on.description: Date and time when the flow was created.

modified_on.description: Date and time when the flow was last modified.

schema.description: Error returned when a query parameter is invalid.

example.detail: Invalid value for order_by, must be one of: name, -name, created_on, -created_on

get.description:
Lists the messages of the project, newest first. Use only one of `folder`, `contact`, `label` or `broadcast` per request, otherwise the request returns a status code `400` error.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a session token issued by Weni Connect. The token identifies the user and the project, and the user must have access to that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Returns the messages of a folder. `inbox` and `flows` list visible incoming messages of that type. `archived` lists archived incoming messages. `outbox` lists outgoing messages waiting to be sent, `sent` lists outgoing messages that were sent or delivered, and `failed` lists outgoing messages that failed. `incoming` lists all incoming messages, ordered by last modification. Any other value returns an empty list. Without `folder`, all messages that are not deleted are listed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Returns only the message with this identifier.

parameters.name: broadcast
parameters.description: Returns only messages that belong to the broadcast with this identifier.

parameters.name: contact
parameters.description: Returns only messages of the contact with this UUID.

parameters.name: urn
parameters.description: Returns only messages of the contact that owns this URN.

parameters.name: label

get.description:
Returns one room of the token's project. Requests are limited to 20 per second, 600 per minute and 30000 per hour.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a project admin token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer {token}`. The token identifies the project, and the caller only sees rooms of that project. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the room.

schema.description: Room.

user.description: Email of the agent assigned to the room, or `null` while it is waiting.

contact_external_id.description: Identifier of the contact in the source system.

is_active.description: Whether the room is still open.

ended_at.description: Date and time when the room ended, or `null` while it is open.

created_on.description: Date and time when the room was created.

waiting_time.description: Seconds the room waited in the queue.

is_deleted.description: Whether the tag has been deleted.

get.description:
Returns how many conversations the project had in a period, and how many were resolved, unresolved or transferred to a human. Each total includes its share of all conversations. The dates are read as calendar days in the project time zone, from the start of `start_date` through the end of `end_date`.

## Permissions

This endpoint requires a bearer token issued by Weni. The token identifies the user and the project, and the totals are always calculated for that project. A project sent in the query string cannot override the token. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: First day of the period, as a date or an ISO 8601 date and time. It must not be after `end_date`.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Last day of the period, as a date or an ISO 8601 date and time.

parameters.name: project_uuid
parameters.description: Project to measure. Required only when the token does not already identify a project. When it does, the token's project is used.

schema.description: Conversation totals for the period.

percentage.description: Share of all conversations. This total is always 100.

Share of all conversations that were not resolved.

transferred_to_human.description: Conversations transferred to a human agent.

value.description: Number of conversations transferred to a human.

percentage.description: Share of all conversations that were transferred to a human.

get.description:
Lists the conversations of a project, newest first. The page also includes `total_count` for the current filters and `status_summary`, which counts each resolution with the `status` and `resolution` filters removed.

## Permissions

This endpoint accepts either an internal service token or a session token issued by Weni Connect, sent as `Authorization: Bearer {token}`. A session token is accepted only when its project is the project in the path. Otherwise, the request returns a status code `403` error.

parameters.name: project_uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the project.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of conversations in the page. Defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor taken from `next` or `previous`. An invalid cursor returns a status code `404` error.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Returns conversations whose contact name or URN contains this text.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Returns conversations that started at or after this date and time.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Returns conversations that started at or before this date and time.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Returns conversations with this resolution code. `0` resolved, `1` unresolved, `2` in progress, `3` unclassified, `4` has a chat room.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Comma-separated resolution codes. A conversation matches any of them. Same codes as `status`.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Comma-separated topic names. `unclassified` includes conversations with no topic. Combined with `subtopics` as one group: a conversation matches either.

parameters.name: subtopics
parameters.description: Comma-separated subtopic UUIDs. Tokens that are not UUIDs are ignored. Combined with `topics` as one group.

parameters.name: csat
parameters.description: Comma-separated satisfaction scores from 1 to 5. Combined with `nps` as one group. Conversations without a survey answer are excluded.

parameters.name: nps
parameters.description: Comma-separated NPS scores. Tokens that are not integers are ignored. Combined with `csat` as one group.

parameters.name: agents
parameters.description: Comma-separated agent UUIDs. A conversation matches when it involved any of them. If none of the tokens are UUIDs, the page is empty.

parameters.name: source_kind
parameters.description: Comma-separated sources. Accepted values are `whatsapp_ads`, `campaign`, `automation`, `ai_suggested_question` and `organic`. Unknown tokens alone match nothing.

parameters.name: has_chats_room
parameters.description: When set, returns only conversations that do or do not have a chat room.

parameters.name: has_conversation_starter
parameters.description: When `true`, only conversations that contain a conversation starter. When `false`, only those that do not.

parameters.name: is_amazing
parameters.description: When `true`, only conversations marked amazing on the latest improvement run. When `false`, only the others.

schema.description: A page of conversations, with totals for the current filters.

next.description: URL of the next page, or `null` on the last page.

previous.description: URL of the previous page, or `null` on the first page.

resolution.description: Resolution code. `0` resolved, `1` unresolved, `2` in progress, `3` unclassified, `4` has a chat room.

start_date.description: Date and time when the conversation started.

end_date.description: Date and time when the conversation ended.

has_chats_room.description: Whether the conversation has a chat room.

has_conversation_starter.description: Whether the conversation contains a conversation starter.

csat.description: Satisfaction score, from 1 (very unsatisfied) to 5 (very satisfied).

nps.description: NPS score, or `null` when the contact did not answer.

topic.description: Topic name. `unclassified` when a closed conversation has no topic. `null` while the conversation is in progress or classification failed.

is_amazing.description: Whether the latest improvement run marked the conversation as amazing.

messages.description: Always `null` on this list. Message bodies are not included.

agents.description: UUIDs of the agents that took part in the conversation.

created_at.description: Date and time when the conversation was created.

total_count.description: Number of conversations that match the current filters, including `status` and `resolution`.

status_summary.description: Count of conversations for each resolution code, using the same filters except `status` and `resolution`. The keys are `0`, `1`, `2`, `3` and `4`.

additionalProperties.description: Number of conversations with that resolution code.

sessionToken.description: Session token issued by Weni Connect, sent as `Authorization: Bearer {token}`. The token identifies both the user and the project, so no project ID is passed in the path or query string.
